workshops.label: Designing for iOS
workshops.scope: Original HTML adaptation. Text scaling and layout changes are browser studies, not native Dynamic Type or iPhone gesture validation.

scenarios.title: Library & return
scenarios.task: Open an article, save it, and return to the same collection.
scenarios.principle: Prioritize primary content; retain an obvious return path.

scenarios.title: Search & no results
scenarios.task: Find an article, then recover from a search with no matches.
scenarios.principle: Make the next action clear in both useful and empty states.

scenarios.title: Edit & cancel
scenarios.task: Edit a note in a focused sheet, validate an empty title, and cancel without losing the original.
scenarios.principle: Keep secondary editing discoverable and preserve the main task.

scenarios.title: Navigation & saved state
scenarios.task: Save an article in Library and find it under Saved without losing its state.
scenarios.principle: Use stable destinations for distinct top-level tasks.

scenarios.title: Adaptable reading
scenarios.task: Change the study width, text size, and appearance while keeping the same reading task.
scenarios.principle: Adapt to the configurations people choose without losing content.

scenarios.title: Loading & recovery
scenarios.task: Load a local collection, cancel it, or simulate a failure and retry.
scenarios.principle: Keep task state and recovery actions understandable.
